brief:
European nations and Canada have condemned Israeli plans to build a new settlement in the E1 area of the West Bank, describing the proposal as "unacceptable," Al Jazeera English reported. Officials from the countries warned that participation in the project would carry "legal and reputational consequences" for those involved in its implementation.

The E1 settlement would extend Israeli control into a strategically significant zone near Jerusalem that separates Palestinian population centers in the West Bank. The joint rebuke from multiple Western governments reflects escalating diplomatic pressure on Israel over its continued settlement expansion in occupied Palestinian territory, a practice that much of the international community views as an obstacle to peace negotiations.
dek: The 'unacceptable' E1 plan carries 'legal and reputational consequences' for those participating, European nations warn.
title: Europe and Canada condemn Israeli West Bank settlement plan
